title: Horn, display, and settings inconveniences
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on inconvenience from horn behavior, display visibility, and settings that cannot be permanently set or switched off, while many fragments are too vague or context-poor to classify cleanly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention feature behavior around the horn or lighting but the supplied examples are sparse and still describe limitations rather than clear benefits.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe inconvenience and dissatisfaction with usability or uncertainty around faults rather than a consistent single issue.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback notes inconvenience because an efficient mode cannot be set permanently when the engine starts.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews include vague complaints about too much tech, default settings, horn activation, and poor visibility, but several fragments lack enough context for a confident sentiment reading.

limitations: This cluster mixes several loosely related usability issues, including horn behavior, display visibility, and configurable settings, rather than one clearly coherent subject.
Many fragments are brief or incomplete, so the underlying problem and sentiment are not always clear from the sample alone.
Some assigned sentiments conflict with the wording of the fragment, so the summaries follow the provided sentiment assignment rather than the text in isolation.
